newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange prepares for futures market.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange prepares for futures market.

text.p: The Istanbul gold exchange is to begin simulated trading on Tuesday for the gold futures market which it plans to open at the beginning of 1997, exchange general secretary Kaan Aytogu said.

"Along with the trial sessions, joint educational programmes by the gold exchange, the Treasury and the Capital Markets Board are in progress to integrate into world futures markets and to provide an environment conforming to international norms," Aytogu told Reuters.
Existing members of Istanbul's gold and stock exchanges must apply to the Capital Markets Board to be able to trade on the Istanbul gold futures market.
